inputs.description: Scene to start with: empty for the entry scene of the project, a name such as start, or a virtual path such as assets://scenes/start.scene.yml

tasks.label: Build
tasks.detail: Builds the chosen preset, and configures it first when its build directory has not been configured yet

tasks.label: Build macos-arm64-debug
tasks.detail: Builds macos-arm64-debug without asking, configuring it first when needed; the launch configurations of that preset run it

tasks.label: Build macos-arm64-release
tasks.detail: Builds macos-arm64-release without asking, configuring it first when needed; the launch configurations of that preset run it

tasks.label: Build linux-x64-debug
tasks.detail: Builds linux-x64-debug without asking, configuring it first when needed; the launch configurations of that preset run it

tasks.label: Build linux-x64-release
tasks.detail: Builds linux-x64-release without asking, configuring it first when needed; the launch configurations of that preset run it

tasks.label: Build windows-x64-debug
tasks.detail: Builds windows-x64-debug without asking, configuring it first when needed; the launch configurations of that preset run it

tasks.label: Build windows-x64-release
tasks.detail: Builds windows-x64-release without asking, configuring it first when needed; the launch configurations of that preset run it

tasks.label: Clean
tasks.detail: Removes what the chosen preset has built, and does nothing when its build directory has not been configured yet

tasks.label: Run
tasks.detail: Runs the macOS build of the chosen preset without a debugger, from the binary's folder so asset paths resolve, with the scene that was asked for or the entry scene of the project
tasks.command: case '${input:preset}' in *-release) TYPE=release ;; *) TYPE=debug ;; esac; SCENE='${input:scene}'; case "$SCENE" in '') ;; *://*) ;; *) SCENE="assets://scenes/$SCENE.scene.yml" ;; esac; cd "${workspaceFolder}/bin/$TYPE/darwin-arm64/NeonRuntime" && ./NeonRuntime ${SCENE:+--scene "$SCENE"}

tasks.label: Full Clean
tasks.detail: Deletes the build directory of the chosen preset and its binaries, so the next Build configures it again
tasks.command: case '${input:preset}' in *-release) TYPE=release ;; *) TYPE=debug ;; esac; rm -rf build/${input:preset} bin/$TYPE/darwin-arm64 bin/$TYPE/linux-* bin/$TYPE/windows-*

tasks.label: Build in Docker (Linux x64)
tasks.command: docker run --rm -v "${workspaceFolder}":/src -w /src neon-engine/linux-x64 sh -c 'cmake --preset linux-x64-${input:buildType} && cmake --build --preset linux-x64-${input:buildType}'

tasks.label: Build in Docker (Windows x64)
tasks.command: docker run --rm -v "${workspaceFolder}":/src -w /src neon-engine/windows-x64 sh -c 'cmake --preset windows-x64-${input:buildType} && cmake --build --preset windows-x64-${input:buildType}'
